meta.title: The priced-import ledger
meta.purpose: Number-One-Goal clause 'mark which types must be imported', made quantitative: price every import in a common currency, each with a falsifier. Rolls up FTD-0336 (frontier), FTD-0059/0096 (calibrations), the constitution's FCs, and the LEDGER's empirical tags. Introduces NO theorem; promotes NOTHING.
meta.currency_note: Five import currencies: adopted-bit (a binary structural choice the substrate cannot force); selected-type (a declared selection among discrete alternatives); named-result (an external mathematical result the spine leans on, proven-elsewhere or open); calibration (a dimensional scale anchor); empirical-identification (a 'this math IS this physics' bridge). Plus a DECLINED column (imports FTD refuses at falsification risk) and a SELF-SET column (what the ontology grounds for itself).
meta.reading_guard: The 'adopted-bit total = 1' is the ALGEBRAIC branch choice of the alpha-sector ONLY (FC-W, the delta sign). It is NOT the total physics import: the empirical identification x+ = 1/alpha [SMC], the ~131 [PARAMETRIC] insertions, and the 3 calibrations are separate, larger debts listed below. Never cite '1 bit' as FTD's total cost of physics.
